summary.name: Playback
summary.one_liner: Playback is an experimental open-source video player built with Electron, Chromium and Node.js that can also live-stream video from BitTorrent magnet links.
use_cases: Playing local MP4 or WebM video files
Watching YouTube videos in a desktop app
Casting video to a Chromecast device
Live streaming video shared via a BitTorrent magnet link
Contributing to an open-source Electron project
summary.what_it_does: Playback is an experimental video player built with Electron (Chromium) and Node.js. According to the page, it supports playing MP4 and WebM files, YouTube videos, and casting to Chromecast. It also supports live streaming of video shared through a BitTorrent magnet link, using WebTorrent. The page invites contributors with HTML, CSS and JS skills and points to issues marked 'help wanted' and a contributing guide.
notable: Live streaming of BitTorrent magnet link video via WebTorrent
caveats: The page does not state which operating systems are supported
